name: ca.validfile/validfile
title: ValidFile
description: Ad specs of each platform (Meta, TikTok, Display…) from its official pages; formats by size.

tools.name: list_format_guides
tools.description: The platforms ValidFile publishes a format guide for (La Presse, Bell Média, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Display banners, Amazon…): for each, its `slug`, its name, how many formats it has, whether ValidFile's monthly check found every one of them on the platform's pages (`verified`, a sentence with its date, or null), and its `url` on validfile.ca. Use it to find the slug get_format_guide takes. Needs no key.

lang.description: The language of the answer: fr (French) or en (English). fr unless given.

tools.name: get_format_guide
tools.description: One platform's specs as ValidFile publishes them: for each format (a placement and its kind, image, video, HTML5…), the size to export (`size`), its lines (`rules`: weight, file types, length, ratio…, each with `refuses`, whether a file is refused on it, and `toConfirm`, whether it only warns on a format not yet confirmed on its official pages, a mark of the format's and not of the line's), the official pages it was read on (`sources`) and its `url` on the guide. Needs no key. Says nothing of a given file: checking one is ValidFile's.

platform.description: The guide's slug from list_format_guides (meta, la-presse, bannieres…), or the platform's name.

lang.description: The language of the answer: fr (French) or en (English). fr unless given.

tools.name: find_formats_by_size
tools.description: The formats, across every format guide ValidFile publishes, whose rules of size and ratio take this many pixels: for 300×250, the banners sold at that size, then the formats whose bounds or ratio it fits. For each: its guide's `slug`, the format's `label` and `kind`, how it fits (`fit`: `exact`, the size it is sold at or its double for sharp screens; `recommended`, the size its platform asks for; `accepted`, within its bounds or ratio; `warns`, taken with a warning), whether that fit is « à confirmer » (`toConfirm`: it rests on what only warns, on a format not yet confirmed on its official pages), the size its guide's card leads with (`size`) and its `url` on its guide. A format that refuses this size, or has no rule of size, is left out. Says nothing of weight, file types or length, which get_format_guide gives, nor of a given file. Needs no key.

kind.description: Only the formats of this kind: image (JPEG, PNG, GIF…), video, or html5 (an HTML5 banner). Every kind unless given.

lang.description: The language of the answer: fr (French) or en (English). fr unless given.
